summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of MedGL (code-based admin, empty DB rebuild). 15/15 pytest backend tests passed (public listing, admin verify wrong/correct, /admin/me auth, module+course+sheet+quiz CRUD with GET verification, reorder, code rotation, cascading delete, final cleanup). Frontend Playwright E2E covered: home hero text 'Vos révisions médicales' + empty state 'Aucun module pour l'instant', /modules empty state, Admin link navigation to /admin-login, wrong-code error, correct-code login → /admin with all 5 sidebar sections (modules/courses/sheets/quizzes/code), module create via UI appearing in admin table AND public /modules, course create + public reader showing content body, QCM creation with 2 questions × 3 choices, interactive QCM play (choose → Valider → feedback → next → final score page showing 100%), admin code rotation to NEW-CODE-2026, logout+re-login with new code, revert to MEDGL-2026, delete module cascading all children, DB left empty, admin code finally back to MEDGL-2026.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx logout() navigates to '/' rather than '/admin-login'. Not a bug — just worth documenting since it is slightly non-obvious; token is cleared from localStorage so user is effectively logged out.

Minor: Backend `create_module` sets order to current module count only when payload order == 0 — if user explicitly sends order=0 for the very first module they get order=0; subsequent modules at order=0 get count-based order. Acceptable but could be more explicit.
Observation: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — fine for this public app since auth is bearer-token based, not cookie-based.

Observation: Admin JWT lifespan 24h with HS256 and JWT_SECRET from env — OK for preview; `JWT_SECRET` value in .env still contains the placeholder 'change-before-production' which is appropriate warning.
test_credentials: Admin code: MEDGL-2026 (restored to this at end of tests). Verified /api/admin/verify with it returns 200.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data left behind. All test modules/courses/sheets/quizzes created during tests were deleted. GET /api/modules returns [] and home shows 'Aucun module pour l'instant'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 15 tests, ~3s). They create TEST_-prefixed data and clean up. Frontend has data-testid everywhere; QCM admin modal requires clicking 'quiz-add-question' first (default is 0 questions). Admin logout redirects to '/' not '/admin-login'. ContentView testid is 'content-view-course' or 'content-view-sheet' (uses prop `kind`, not URL slug).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Both backend APIs and frontend flows work end-to-end on the public preview URL.
